clinical_intent: I need to create a clinical pathway for the management of early-stage endometrial cancer suitable for brachytherapy. The pathway should include: (1) diagnostic workup and staging requirements, (2) multidisciplinary tumor board criteria, (3) patient selection for definitive brachytherapy, (4) treatment delivery protocol (fractionation, applicator selection, dose specification), (5) follow-up schedule and surveillance, and (6) criteria for treatment response assessment. Please provide this as a flowchart-style pathway document.
